dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible symmetrical narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle, following a linear-to-concave geometric path.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Symmetrical indentation at the cranial-dorsal junction, creating a distinct 'neck' profile; remaining lateral margins are smooth and free of localized bulges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with a high-intensity reflectance and very light greyish-blue undertones.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low frequency; sparse, faint grey linear streaks are localized on the lateral dorsal planes.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the mature white primary pigment and the faint grey linear markings.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of thin, low-contrast multi-directional linear marks (healed rake marks) across the mid-dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Deep longitudinal groove/cleft along the central dorsal axis beginning mid-body and extending toward the posterior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple faint, overlapping linear healed scars (rake marks) visible across the dorsal plane.
